name: Apache Cassandra
summary: A distributed partitioned wide-column database that routes mutations by token ownership, persists writes through a commit log and memtables, flushes SSTables, and exposes tunable consistency levels.

features.name: Partitioned wide-column data model
features.description: Cassandra represents table data as partitioned rows and routes partitions using token ownership; its storage and read/write paths operate on partition updates rather than a single globally ordered table.
benefits: Makes partition key and locality central to data placement
costs: Poor partition-key choices can create hotspots or oversized partitions
Cross-partition queries and transactions require additional coordination

features.name: Commit log, memtable, and SSTable persistence
features.description: The source contains commit-log services, commit-log replay, memtable implementations, and ColumnFamilyStore flush paths that move in-memory partition updates into SSTables.
benefits: Separates fast append/recovery state from sorted immutable storage
Allows flush and compaction work to be scheduled independently of request handling
costs: Commit-log, memory, flush, and compaction resources must be tuned together
Recovery and disk amplification depend on outstanding memtable and log state

features.name: Token-based replicated topology
features.description: NetworkTopologyStrategy and StorageProxy source coordinate token ranges, replica placement, datacenter-aware topology, and coordinator-to-replica requests.
benefits: Distributes partitions and replicas across nodes and datacenters
Permits topology-aware placement and repair workflows
costs: Membership, replica movement, repair, and topology changes add operational complexity
Replica placement and coordinator locality affect latency and availability

features.name: Tunable consistency at request coordination
features.description: The request path exposes consistency levels and response handlers so reads and writes can wait for configured replica acknowledgements rather than one fixed global quorum.
benefits: Lets workloads choose latency, availability, and replica agreement points
Makes consistency a visible request-level policy
costs: Different levels expose different stale-read and failure behavior
Applications must select and test a level compatible with their invariants

features.name: Replay and hinted recovery mechanisms
features.description: The source includes commit-log replay and failure-handling paths that preserve or reapply mutations when ordinary replica coordination cannot immediately complete.
benefits: Supports recovery after process or node interruption
Separates temporary replica unavailability from immediate loss of the mutation path
costs: Hints, replay, repair, and later convergence add background work
Recovery correctness depends on timestamps, topology, and replay ordering

mathematical_views.question: How does a logical wide-column table refine into partition keys, token ranges, replicas, memtables, and SSTables?
assumptions: Partition keys determine the modeled placement function
Replica placement is explicit state rather than inferred from latency

mathematical_views.question: For a configured consistency level, which replica responses are sufficient for a read or write to return?
assumptions: The consistency level maps to a defined response threshold
Coordinator and replica failures are modeled as partial progress
Returning success is distinguished from all replicas having converged

mathematical_views.question: Which commit-log, memtable, and SSTable transitions reconstruct partition state after node restart?
assumptions: Mutation records are replayed according to commit-log ordering and metadata
Flush boundaries and already durable SSTables are represented
Repair and hinted handoff are modeled as later convergence paths

costs: Partition-key design and cross-partition work are application constraints

benefits: Fast durable append plus immutable storage
costs: Flush, compaction, memory, and replay resource pressure
Placement, movement, repair, and membership complexity
